summary: Add written practice and a guided teaching prompt for explaining catalytic effects and interpreting pathway diagrams.

improvements.why: The 23 current items are predominantly MCQs, with no written Explain response about the Boltzmann distribution.
improvements.what: Add two short or structured Explain items: one links an unchanged distribution at fixed temperature, lower $E_a$, larger area beyond the threshold and increased rate; the other contrasts heating with catalysis on a Boltzmann plot. Give markable rubric points and three non-answer hints.

improvements.why: The single Sketch item does not give varied practice interpreting forward and reverse first-step barriers on a multi-step pathway.
improvements.what: Add one structured interpretation of an endothermic or multi-step catalysed pathway, marking $E_a$ from the starting level in each named direction, and one numerical barrier calculation from supplied energy levels. Make the diagram or levels unambiguous.

improvements.why: The pack has no teaching cards, so the tutor lacks a guided discovery prompt for its central visual comparison.
improvements.what: Add a teaching card with a discover question asking what changes on the existing Boltzmann diagram when a catalyst is added at fixed temperature; guide the learner from the unchanged curve to the left-shifted $E_a$ threshold and larger reacting fraction.
